notablePrerequisites:
You control three other creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter's ability targeting Angel of Destiny by paying {2}{U} and exiling it from your graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature and making each other creature you control become a copy of it until end of turn.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.
